Pressure Cooker Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 11:46pm

Ingredients




1 (3 lb.) chicken, cut up
1 (1.2 oz.) pkg. onion soup mix
2 cups water

Preparation

1 Place the chicken in the pressure cooker, add the water, sprinkle the dried onion soup mix over the chicken. Heat until steam starts to come out. Add the pressure top. Bring to 15 pounds pressure. Cook for 15 minutes at 15 pounds. Turn off heat. Allow the pressure to reduce to normal.
